scope: The first two "What does this mean?" units; all later source units are outside the bounded fixture.

native_units.question: What does this mean?
native_units.answer: We must fear, love, and trust God more than anything else.

native_units.question: What does this mean?
native_units.answer: We must fear and love God, so that we will not use His name to curse, swear, cast a spell, lie or deceive, but will use it to call upon Him, pray to Him, praise Him and thank Him in all times of trouble.

native_units.question: What does this mean?
native_units.answer: We must fear and love God, so that we will not look down on preaching or God's Word, but consider it holy, listen to it willingly, and learn it.

native_units.question: What does this mean?
native_units.answer: We must fear and love God, so that we will neither look down on our parents or superiors nor irritate them, but will honor them, serve them, obey them, love them and value them.

native_units.question: What does this mean?
native_units.answer: We must fear and love God, so that we will neither harm nor hurt our neighbor's body, but help him and care for him when he is ill.

native_units.question: What does this mean?
native_units.answer: We must fear and love God, so that our words and actions will be clean and decent and so that everyone will love and honor their spouses.

native_units.question: What does this mean?
native_units.answer: We must fear and love God, so that we will neither take our neighbor's money or property, nor acquire it by fraud or by selling him poorly made products, but will help him improve and protect his property and career.

native_units.question: What does this mean?
native_units.answer: We must fear and love God, so that we will not deceive by lying, betraying, slandering or ruining our neighbor's reputation, but will defend him, say good things about him, and see the best side of everything he does.

native_units.question: What does this mean?
native_units.answer: We must fear and love God, so that we will not attempt to trick our neighbor out of his inheritance or house, take it by pretending to have a right to it, etc. but help him to keep & improve it.

native_units.question: What does this mean?
native_units.answer: We must fear and love God, so that we will not release our neighbor's cattle, take his employees from him or seduce his wife, but urge them to stay and do what they ought to do.

native_units.question: What does this mean?
native_units.answer: I believe that God created me, along with all creatures. He gave to me: my body and soul, my eyes, ears and all the other parts of my body, my mind and all my senses. He preserves them as well. He gives me clothing and shoes, food and drink, house and land, wife and children, fields, animals and all I own. Every day He abundantly provides everything I need to nourish this body and life. He protects me against all danger. he shields and defends me from all evil. He does all this because of His pure, fatherly and divine goodness and His mercy, not because I've earned it or deserved it. For all of this, I must thank Him, praise Him, serve Him and obey Him. Yes, this is true!

native_units.question: What does this mean?
native_units.answer: I believe that Jesus Christ is truly God, born of the Father in eternity and also truly man, born of the Virgin Mary. He is my Lord! He redeemed me, a lost and condemned person, bought and won me from all sins, death and the authority of the Devil. It did not cost Him gold or silver, but His holy, precious blood, His innocent body--His death! Because of this, I am His very own, will live under Him in His kingdom and serve Him righteously, innocently and blessedly forever, just as He is risen from death, lives and reigns forever. Yes, this is true.

native_units.question: What does this mean?
native_units.answer: I believe that I cannot come to my Lord Jesus Christ by my own intelligence or power. But the Holy Spirit called me by the Gospel, enlightened me with His gifts, made me holy and kept me in the true faith, just as He calls, gathers together, enlightens and makes holy the whole Church on earth and keeps it with Jesus in the one, true faith. In this Church, He generously forgives each day every sin committed by me and by every believer. On the last day, He will raise me and all the dead from the grave. He will give eternal life to me and to all who believe in Christ. Yes, this is true!

native_units.question: What does this mean?
native_units.answer: In this introduction, God invites us to believe that He is our real Father and we are His real children, so that we will pray with trust and complete confidence, in the same way beloved children approach their beloved Father with their requests.

native_units.question: What does this mean?
native_units.answer: Of course, God's name is holy in and of itself, but by this request, we pray that He will make it holy among us, too.

native_units.question: What does this mean?
native_units.answer: Truly God's Kingdom comes by itself, without our prayer. But we pray in this request that it come to us as well.

native_units.question: What does this mean?
native_units.answer: Truly, God's good and gracious will is accomplished without our prayer. But we pray in this request that is accomplished among us as well.

native_units.question: What does this mean?
native_units.answer: Truly, God gives daily bread to evil people, even without our prayer. But we pray in this request that He will help us realize this and receive our daily bread with thanksgiving.

native_units.question: What does this mean?
native_units.answer: We pray in this request that our Heavenly Father will neither pay attention to our sins nor refuse requests such as these because of our sins and because we are neither worthy nor deserve the things for which we pray. Yet He wants to give them all to us by His grace, because many times each day we sin and truly deserve only punishment. Because God does this, we will, of course, want to forgive from our hearts and willingly do good to those who sin against us.

native_units.question: What does this mean?
native_units.answer: God tempts no one, of course, but we pray in this request that God will protect us and save us, so that the Devil, the world and our bodily desires will neither deceive us nor seduce us into heresy, despair or other serious shame or vice, and so that we will win and be victorious in the end, even if they attack us.

native_units.question: What does this mean?
native_units.answer: We pray in this request, as a summary, that our Father in Heaven will save us from every kind of evil that threatens body, soul, property and honor. We pray that when at last our final hour has come, He will grant us a blessed death, and, in His grace, bring us to Himself from this valley of tears.  Amen

native_units.question: What does this mean?
native_units.answer: That I should be certain that such prayers are acceptable to the Father in Heaven and will be granted, that He Himself has commanded us to pray in this way and that He promises to answer us. Amen. Amen. This means: Yes, yes it will happen this way.

selected_units.question: What does this mean?
selected_units.answer: We must fear, love, and trust God more than anything else.
